title: Perplexity thwarts Time's ads for AI bots experiment
excerpt: Perplexity said ads designed to influence AI bots are "deceptive," in response to a recent experiment from the publisher Time.
content_html:
The dream of serving ads to AI agents has hit a snag

By Lara O'Reilly

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Author of the CMO Insider newsletter

Now the bots see them. Now they don't.

Brands including Ally Bank and the Project Management Institute recently began testing ads on the publisher Time's website, specifically designed to be read by AI bots.

The experiment sparked a lively ad industry debate: Could this nascent form of advertising grow into a credible channel, or would the practice be quickly thwarted by the AI platforms they are hoping to target?

AI search company Perplexity decided it doesn't want to play ball.

Digiday reported that Perplexity has begun preventing these ads from influencing its models. In a statement, the company warned publishers that running "deceptive advertising," such as this new format, could result in them being downranked in its search index.

A quick recap:

  • Time recently created stripped-down, text-only versions of its webpages designed to be read by AI agents.
  • Time is directing AI crawlers to read those pages rather than the ones humans see.
  • It then began working with the adtech company Mobian to place "Agent Ads" on those pages.
  • These ads render as blocks of FAQ-like text with up-to-date facts about the advertised brand.

The central idea is that the ads could help companies leverage the "authority" of publishers like Time and improve their chances of showing up accurately inside chatbots like ChatGPT and Gemini.

Jonah Goodhart, CEO of Mobian, said agent ads are clearly labeled and present cited, verifiable facts about brands that models can choose whether to use.

"This is the opposite of deception," Goodhart told me.

Perplexity spokesman Jesse Dwyer said that serving one page to people and a different page to their software is called "cloaking," which search engines have long penalized.

"You can't just rebrand spam," Dwyer told me. "If the ads are so helpful, why not just put them right on the site for everyone to see?"

I also asked a few other prominent AI platforms whether they would follow Perplexity's lead. OpenAI and Google declined to comment, and Anthropic didn't respond.

Time COO Mark Howard said in a statement that the publisher has contacted Perplexity and is looking forward to "a constructive dialogue about the standards and safeguards that will allow advertising and AI to develop responsibly together."

Meanwhile, PMI CMO Menaka Gopinath described its AI ads experiment with Time as part of its "learning journey" to see how information about project management, skills, and career development surfaces in AI-driven environments.

Like many marketing experiments, sometimes it's not all about the ROI, but the lessons we learn along the way!

content_html_zh:
为人工智能代理提供广告的梦想遇到了障碍

作者：Lara O'Reilly 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。 CMO Insider 时事通讯的作者

现在机器人看到了它们。 现在他们不这样做了。

包括 Ally Bank 和 Project Management Institute 在内的品牌最近开始在出版商时代网站上测试广告，这些广告是专门为人工智能机器人阅读而设计的。

该实验引发了广告行业的激烈争论：这种新兴的广告形式能否发展成为可靠的渠道，或者这种做法是否会很快被他们希望瞄准的人工智能平台所阻挠？

人工智能搜索公司 Perplexity 决定不再合作。

Digiday 报道称，Perplexity 已开始阻止这些广告影响其模型。 该公司在一份声明中警告出版商，运行“欺骗性广告”（例如这种新格式）可能会导致他们在搜索索引中的排名下降。

快速回顾一下：

  • 《时代》杂志最近创建了精简的纯文本版本的网页，旨在供人工智能代理阅读。
  • 时间正在引导人工智能爬虫阅读这些页面，而不是人类看到的页面。
  • 然后，它开始与广告技术公司 Mobian 合作，在这些页面上放置“代理广告”。
  • 这些广告呈现为类似于常见问题解答的文本块，其中包含有关广告品牌的最新事实。

其中心思想是，这些广告可以帮助公司利用《时代》杂志等出版商的“权威”，并提高在 ChatGPT 和 Gemini 等聊天机器人中准确展示的机会。

Mobian 首席执行官乔纳·古德哈特 (Jonah Goodhart) 表示，代理广告有明确的标签，并提供有关品牌的引用的、可验证的事实，模特可以选择是否使用。

“这与欺骗相反，”古德哈特告诉我。

Perplexity 发言人杰西·德怀尔 (Jesse Dwyer) 表示，向人们提供一个页面并向他们的软件提供不同的页面被称为“伪装”，搜索引擎长期以来一直对这种行为进行惩罚。

“你不能只是重新命名垃圾邮件，”德怀尔告诉我。 “如果这些广告如此有帮助，为什么不把它们放在网站上让每个人都可以看到呢？”

我还询问了其他一些著名的人工智能平台，他们是否会效仿 Perplexity 的做法。 OpenAI 和谷歌拒绝置评，Anthropic 也没有回应。

《时代》杂志首席运营官马克·霍华德在一份声明中表示，该出版商已联系 Perplexity，并期待“就标准和保障措施进行建设性对话，使广告和人工智能能够负责任地共同发展。”

与此同时，PMI 首席营销官梅纳卡·戈皮纳特 (Menaka Gopinath) 将其与《时代》杂志的人工智能广告实验描述为“学习之旅”的一部分，旨在了解有关项目管理、技能和职业发展的信息如何在人工智能驱动的环境中呈现。

就像许多营销实验一样，有时这并不完全取决于投资回报率，而是我们一路上学到的经验教训！

Lara O'Reilly 是 CMO Insider 时事通讯的主播。她是一名高级记者，自 2010 年以来一直报道数字广告、营销和媒体行业。 她目前的工作范围包括 Alphabet、Meta 等大型科技公司，以及广告科技公司、代理机构、出版商、创作者经济和 CMO。Lara 此前曾在《华尔街日报》、《Digiday》、《雅虎财经》和《营销周刊》等杂志担任记者和执行制片人。 她曾于 2014 年至 2017 年担任 Business Insider 的全球高级广告编辑。Lara 是电视和广播电台的常客，并出现在 BBC、NPR、SiriusXM 的沃顿商业日报和 CTV 电视网络等媒体上。 她还经常在 Web Summit、IFA、VivaTech、Advertising Week 和 Cannes Lions 等重大活动的舞台上发表演讲。 要与 Lara O'Reilly 取得联系，请发送电子邮件至 loreilly@businessinsider.com 或通过 Signal 与她联系：@loreilly.71
